pool.text: Queen Saw Pu built a palace next to the Shwedagon Pagoda.
Queen Saw Pu spent her semi-retired life at her palace until she died.
King Alaungpaya captured Dagon and called the enlarged town Yangon.
The estimated population of Yangon was about thirty thousand people.
The city of Yangon was completely destroyed by a massive fire.
The British captured Yangon and Lower Burma during a war.
Yangon became the capital of all British-ruled Burma after the war.
Yangon was under Japanese occupation and incurred heavy damage during the war.
The city of Yangon was successfully retaken by the Allies.
Yangon became the capital of the Union of Burma upon independence.
The military junta changed the English name of the city.
The committee created a heritage list of old buildings and structures.
Driving motorcycles within the city limits of Yangon became illegal.
A series of coordinated bombings occurred in the city of Yangon.
A major cyclone named Cyclone Nargis hit the city of Yangon.
The economy size of the Yangon Region was officially measured.
The city imposed a long moratorium on the demolition of old buildings.
The new city bus network system named YBS was created.
Life in Yangon was greatly affected by the coup d'etat.
The districts of Yangon Region were reorganised into nine new districts.
